input.quote: For the acceptance period and for a period of one year from the Maintenance Commencement Date, and thereafter for as long as the Software is covered by Maintenance Services and is used by Sparkling in accordance with this Agreement, Garman warrants that the Software shall perform in conformance with the Specifications in all material respects.
input.rationale: Section 12 gives an express conformance warranty running through the acceptance period, a full year from the Maintenance Commencement Date and thereafter for as long as Maintenance Services continue — at or above the preferred 12-month software warranty. A real remedy exists: Garman must repair non-conforming Software at no charge under the Software Repair Service (§10(c)/p0077), and a full refund of all amounts paid is available if the Software is rejected on acceptance (§8(b)). Critically, there is no "AS IS" or implied-warranty disclaimer anywhere in the agreement, so nothing swallows the express warranty, and §15 preserves direct damages. Sub-elements short of the preferred wording — no separate professional-and-workmanlike services warranty, no express compliance-with-laws or no-malicious-code warranties, and repair rather than an express repair/replace/refund election — are noted but are not material deviations given the longer-than-preferred period and the refund path on rejection. No redline proposed.
